envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: Correct the shard after execution established that Claude native Agent calls expose no per-call machine-enforced response schema.

payload.gloss: the caller-declared return shape at a delegation seam: every dispatch supplies the schema for that particular seam, and the delegate returns only a value conforming to it, so prose cannot masquerade as a route, verdict or landing. The dispatcher owns the schema; a role's default output shape is neither the contract nor required beside it. Where the harness offers per-call schema enforcement, the schema is strict and a mismatch is refused at the seam as a failed dispatch, never recorded as a design note or broken whole and never retried automatically. A supported harness without that native seam receives the highest-fidelity projection it offers and an explicit statement of the shortfall, never a false parity claim or invented transport. Unit-loop seams derive their shape from the receiving role and pin the unit's name where applicable; ad-hoc seams declare the shape their request requires. The unit itself carries no transport contract.
